property.name: NVR Address
property.description: IP address of the UniFi OS console.

property.name: Snapshots
property.description: Applied to every camera on the next Create / Update or Push Settings.

property.name: Enable RTSP in Protect
property.description: RTSP is off by default in Protect for every camera. Yes lets each camera driver switch it on if it finds no stream enabled.

property.name: Detect Person
property.description: Pushed to every camera: fire person events and set the variable.

property.name: History - Person
property.description: Pushed to every camera: record person events in the Control4 History timeline.

property.name: Detect Vehicle
property.description: Pushed to every camera: fire vehicle events and set the variable.

property.name: History - Vehicle
property.description: Pushed to every camera: record vehicle events in the Control4 History timeline.

property.name: Detect Animal
property.description: Pushed to every camera: fire animal events and set the variable.

property.name: History - Animal
property.description: Pushed to every camera: record animal events in the Control4 History timeline.

property.name: Detect Package
property.description: Pushed to every camera: fire package events and set the variable.

property.name: History - Package
property.description: Pushed to every camera: record package events in the Control4 History timeline.

property.name: Detect Motion
property.description: Pushed to every camera: fire motion events and set the variable.

property.name: History - Motion
property.description: Pushed to every camera: record motion events in the Control4 History timeline.

property.name: Detect Doorbell
property.description: Pushed to every camera: fire doorbell events and set the variable.

property.name: History - Doorbell
property.description: Pushed to every camera: record doorbell events in the Control4 History timeline.

property.name: History Cooldown
property.description: Pushed to every camera: seconds before the same event type is recorded again.

action.name: Create / Update Cameras
action.description: Adds a camera driver for every Protect camera that does not have one, and pushes settings to all of them. Safe to run repeatedly.

action.name: Push Settings to Cameras
action.description: Sends the current address, API key and snapshot setting to every managed camera. Use after rotating the API key.

action.name: Forget Managed Cameras
action.description: Clears this driver's list. Camera drivers are not removed; the next Create / Update adopts them again.
